title: brathys drummondii
intro: Brathys drummondii, commonly known as Desert Marigold, is a flowering plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is known for its bright yellow and orange flowers, which bloom from February to April, and its greenish-yellow foliage. The health benefits of Brathys drummondii include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
